reason: Yes. The measured defect is real and the bill replaces an unsatisfiable rule with a prospective, fail-closed convention: state-directory record bound to exact commit/tree/parent, canonical detached digest, board pin with fallback, mandatory content assertions, bounded Clerk-authored post-landing copy, Git copy authoritative, exact-commit fast-forward, non-retroactive. The content-assertion requirement directly addresses the 87100ca failure (a count-only pass that misattributed its enactment to M-024). I knowingly accept the four residuals in section 9.3: U1 the pin proves existence at the pin rather than before the build, U2 the board is neither immutable nor always available, U3 any main commit still voids and a fifth dead candidate remains possible, U4 the beneficiary requested the rule. U3 is the main residual; I would support a follow-on freeze/queue or tree+base bill if it recurs. Act 22 does not bind this bill: section 8 limits the pilot to Innovation Centre/Clerk bills and predict-gate returned not_exercised, so no predictions are registered lawfully, not as an excuse. The red-teamer reviewed the prior draft and voted yes on this revised text; section 7a's predictions lack probabilities and should not be retrofitted. This is a vote for a real but incomplete improvement, not a claim that it is clean.
